scripts.build: wxt build -b chrome && wxt build -b firefox && wxt build -b edge
scripts.zip: wxt zip -b chrome && wxt zip -b firefox && wxt zip -b edge
scripts.deploy: wxt build -b firefox && wxt zip -b firefox && wxt submit --firefox-zip .output/$(node -p "require('./package.json').name+'-'+require('./package.json').version+'-firefox.zip'") --firefox-sources-zip .output/$(node -p "require('./package.json').name+'-'+require('./package.json').version+'-sources.zip'")
